articles.title: Swift Smashes 65-Year Record: First Artist with 4 Simultaneous Adult Contemporary Top 10s
articles.summary: Taylor Swift just pulled off a chart feat unseen since the Adult Contemporary chart began in 1961: four songs in the top 10 at once. 'Elizabeth Taylor' joined three other hits, making her the first non-holiday artist to do it.

articles.title: Chart Watch: Stella Lefty, Yung Miami, and Malcolm Todd Eye Top 10 Breakthroughs
articles.summary: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' rules the Hot 100 for a 12th week, but three fast-rising hits are poised to shake up the top tier. Stella Lefty's 'Boston,' Yung Miami's 'Spend Dat,' and Malcolm Todd's 'Earrings' all hit new peaks.

articles.title: Letterboxd's $250M Sale Talks Heat Up: Sony, Netflix, and Reddit Co-Founder in the Mix
articles.summary: Cinephile haven Letterboxd is exploring a sale, with Sony, Netflix, Paramount, and Alexis Ohanian among potential suitors. The platform's owner, Tiny, seeks a $250 million valuation—five times its 2023 purchase price—sparking fan anxiety over its future.
